_comment: Manual corrections to Game8 item categories.
Each entry fully REPLACES the Game8 category for that item.
An empty array [] clears the category (use sparingly; defaults to 'Other').
Valid categories are listed in lib/types.js → ITEM_CATEGORIES:
Stat Boost, Power Boost, Defense, Recovery, Effect Extend,
Items not listed here fall back to their Game8 category, then to 'Other'.
